edges: Benham's mother left his father for a wealthy man named Nolan.
Nolan left a large fortune to Mrs. Benham and her son.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Benham had conflicts with his friend Prothero.
Benham left Amanda behind in England to travel the world.
White produced the novel to fulfill a promise to Benham.
Benham was fatally shot in Johannesburg while attempting to stop soldiers firing at strikers.
